recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If Patient Care wants AllergyIntolerance to include a direct reference to Condition, Procedure, or other supporting clinical context, that should be handled by a new explicit design issue rather than inferred from FHIR-20189.
issue_request: FHIR-20189 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care R5 change request asking to add "Presumed" to AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus and to allow Condition context in AllergyIntolerance. The recorded resolution defined confirmed, unconfirmed, and presumed, with presumed as a child of unconfirmed.
initial_application: Commit 89170aaa03115a9f408c1cf12fac8d86c2694e48 explicitly applied GF#20189 by adding presumed under unconfirmed in the old in-core AllergyIntolerance verification CodeSystem and updating the verificationStatus short code list. It did not add a new Reference(Condition) element.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini and remains Patient Care/FMM 6. The old verification CodeSystem was later removed from core during UTG/THO migration, while the current core ValueSet includes the THO CodeSystem that now carries presumed. Current AllergyIntolerance.code and its value set already support allergy or intolerance condition/statements, and later FHIR-35848 resolved Not Persuasive to excluding conditions from AllergyIntolerance.code because that broad scope is intentional.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source and published build already carry the approved presumed verification status, and adding a new direct Condition reference would exceed the recorded resolution and later WG/source context.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue broadened AllergyIntolerance.code value-set naming to include condition and negation codes.
Later Resolved - No Change decision kept conditions in AllergyIntolerance.code and stated profiles can restrict the value set when needed.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting Presumed for AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus and Condition context for AllergyIntolerance; resolution defines presumed under unconfirmed.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final approved verification-status semantics to check in current source.

evidence_items.summary: GF#20189 commit added presumed to the old in-core AllergyIntolerance verification CodeSystem and short code list.

evidence_items.summary: AllergyIntolerance is active in resources/workgroups/security/FMM, and verificationStatus currently lists unconfirmed | presumed | confirmed | refuted | entered-in-error with a required binding.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope StructureDefinition already carries the presumed code in the element contract.

evidence_items.summary: The current THO CodeSystem includes presumed as a child of unconfirmed with the FHIR-20189 definition.
evidence_items.learned: The terminology source referenced by the current core ValueSet contains the requested code.

evidence_items.summary: AllergyIntolerance.code is defined as an allergy/intolerance statement and may be a substance/product, an allergy or intolerance condition, or a negation/exclusion code.
evidence_items.learned: The current source supports condition statements without adding a separate Condition reference element.

evidence_items.summary: Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive issue declined excluding conditions from AllergyIntolerance.code because the code definition supports conditions/statements.
evidence_items.learned: Later WG context supports leaving the condition representation as part of AllergyIntolerance.code rather than adding a speculative reference.
